items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: So I meet Steele(?). Paul would say, 'Steele(?), look out for him... Steele(?) said, 'I'll pull his coat.' So Steele(?) would tell me everything...always... I've never forgotten. He always kept explaining me things until I left New York.

ctx.x: Steele(?) was a drummer... He'd been a waiter until he finally started playing drums. And he was from Florida, and he had migrated to New York as a kid. He was...
